sideB.text:
It's over. The fate of humanity was in your hands.

Look at the following two cards to see what happens next, then calculate your score to determine the ultimate fate of your world.

mechanics.whenRead: Leave this face undrawn during December setup. Draw it after step 4 of Game End when December is won, or when the second December game is lost. Do not read it after a first December loss.
triggers: After step 4 of Game End if you win in December
After step 4 of Game End if you lose your second game in December
rules: Do not draw this card after a first December loss.
Look at the next two cards, 12-06 (failed to deliver) and 12-07 (delivered the sample), and read the one that matches the outcome.
Then calculate the campaign score on 12-08 and read the matching ending tier on 12-09 through 12-12.
mechanics.notes: Side B does not name 12-06 and 12-07. They are the next two cards in the deck. Scoring is 12-08. The tier cards split by whether the sample was delivered.
